name: Diluvicursor
sum: A small ornithopod from the Early Cretaceous Eumeralla Formation of Victoria, Australia, known from a juvenile partial postcranium.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: A partial juvenile postcranium found in 2005 in the Eumeralla Formation, Victoria (specimen number not read).
biology: Deposited in a high-energy river; the animal probably lived on a floodplain. Little else is known of its biology.
author: Herne et al. 2018
